chunks.text: Before we start... jetdabest1 has been here since day one. Their dog Lana just passed away. She was the best. This episode is for Lana.
Day nine. You voted B... tell Dez first. So I ran to the groundskeeper's shed and told him everything. The legend. The fifty likes. Barcelona.
He didn't smile. He just said: Barcelona doesn't want tricks. They want a player.
That night it was raining at the street pitch. Then I heard something by the fence. A little puppy. Soaked. Alone.
I gave her half my sandwich. She wouldn't leave my side. So I named her Lana.
Now she comes to every session. Dez says she has a better first touch than me.
Training with Dez was brutal. Weak foot only. First touch under pressure. Then shots until my legs gave out. Lana chased every single ball back.
At midnight Dez finally smiled. When you go to Barcelona... I'm coming with you.
Card check. Passing: thirty-four to thirty-seven. Physical: twenty-five to thirty. Overall... thirty-two!
But Barcelona is far... and I've got thirty dollars left.
